displayName: Sweet Alyssum + Stone Fruit (orchard floor banker plant)
benefit: Sweet alyssum in orchard floor strips supports syrphid flies and parasitic wasps that suppress aphid colonies on stone fruit and host braconid wasps that attack oriental fruit moth larvae.

members.title: Alyssum strip on tree row centerline
members.body: Direct-sow sweet alyssum in a 12 to 18 inch strip down the tree row centerline after bloom. Refresh seeding annually.
